title: How to build an agent that builds the culture — Zach Bruggeman, Ramp
summary: Zach Bruggeman says Inspect now writes and ships around 75% of Ramp’s code. At CODE Summit 2026, he explains the engineering culture behind that adoption: shared agent tooling, open internal sessions and visible verification. A telemetry bug and the Review Buddy code review agent show how multiplayer AI coding can break information silos, build trust and help teams think bigger …
